title: Hello World: Meet Azimjon
description: An introduction to Azimjon Abdurasulov, a Creative Developer & Software Engineer bridging the gap between business needs and technology.
content:
# Hello World: Meet Azimjon

**Hi, I'm Azimjon Abdurasulov.**

I don't just write code; I provide solutions for business challenges. From mobile apps to web platforms and automation, I turn your ideas into reality. I bridge the gap between business needs and technology. Whether it's a mobile app, website, or complex backend system, I solve problems through code.

## My Journey

As a Software Engineer, I don't limit myself to a single technology. My goal is to use the most effective tools to deliver the best results. I offer comprehensive services ranging from building high-quality iOS (Swift) apps to automating business processes using Python and AI.

I understand the language of both business owners and users. I know you don't just need a "website" or an "app"—you need a **SYSTEM** that attracts customers, increases sales, and saves time. My expertise is focused on building and launching such systems from scratch.

## What I Do

### 📱 iOS & Mobile Development
Building high-performance, user-centric mobile applications for iPhone, iPad, and Apple Watch. I specialize in Native iOS App Development (Swift/SwiftUI) and Cross-platform solutions (Flutter/React Native).

### 📺 Smart TV Apps
I develop streaming and utility applications for major TV platforms including Samsung Tizen, LG WebOS, VIDAA (Hisense), and Android TV.

### 🤖 Business Automation & Bots
Delegating routine tasks to robots. I build custom Telegram bots and Python automation scripts to minimize errors and save time for your business.

### 🖥️ IT Infrastructure
Complete hardware and network solutions for businesses, offices, and gaming clubs, including server setup, local area network (LAN) design, and IP camera installation.

## Let's Connect

I'm currently open to freelance projects and full-time opportunities. If you have an idea you want to bring to life, let's talk.

[LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/azimjon-abdurasulov/) • [Contact Me](/en/contact)
